structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: Obtaining controlled paraphernalia by fraud, etc

text.section: No person shall obtain or attempt to obtain any item, device or substance referred to in § 54.1-3467 by fraud, deceit, misrepresentation, or subterfuge or by giving a false name or a false address.

No person shall furnish false or fraudulent information in or omit any information from, or willfully make a false statement in obtaining or attempting to obtain any of the instruments or substances referred to in § 54.1-3467.

No person shall, for the purpose of obtaining any such instrument or substance, falsely claim to be a manufacturer, wholesaler, pharmacist, practitioner of the healing arts, funeral director, embalmer or veterinarian. Persons violating the provisions of this section shall be guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.
